name: Crystal Crop Protection
summary: Crystal Crop Protection, founded in 1994, sells herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, plant growth regulators and seeds in India through more than 13,000 distributors and exports selected products. In the RHP, revenue from operations rose 17.2% to ₹3,152 cr in FY26 and profit after tax rose 22.4% to ₹144.9 cr, though return on equity stayed below 8%. At the upper band the company is valued at about ₹4,438 cr, or about 30.6x FY26 profit, below the median of its listed agrochemical peers. Of the ₹354.8 cr fresh issue, ₹270 cr (about 76%) goes to repaying debt of the company and its subsidiary Saffire Crop Science, and the ₹100.7 cr offer for sale is by promoter Ankur Aggarwal.

fh1.finding: Revenue from operations rose from ₹2,230 cr in FY24 to ₹3,152 cr in FY26, a CAGR of about 18.9%.

fh2.finding: Revenue grew in both of the last 2 years: about 20.7% in FY25 and 17.2% in FY26 to ₹3,152 cr.

fh3.finding: Debt to equity was about 0.40 at March 2026 (borrowings ₹820 cr vs net worth ₹2,040 cr).

fh4.finding: Borrowings rose about 42% (₹577 cr to ₹820 cr) over FY24–FY26, slightly faster than revenue (about 41%).

fh5.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹1,488 cr (FY24), ₹1,600 cr (FY25) and ₹2,040 cr (FY26).

fh6.finding: Operating cash flow figures were not found in public sources.

pr1.finding: Profit after tax grew 22.4% in FY26, to ₹144.9 cr from ₹118.4 cr.

pr2.finding: PAT margin improved from about 3.9% (FY24) to 4.4% (FY25) and 4.6% (FY26).

pr3.finding: Return on equity was 7.94% in FY26.

pr5.finding: Listed-peer margins were not found in public sources.

va1.finding: P/E is about 30.6x FY26 profit at ₹272, below the listed-peer median of about 37.7x.

va2.finding: Post-issue price to book is about 1.9x (₹4,438 cr market cap vs about ₹2,395 cr post-issue net worth), below the peer median of about 5.2x.

va3.finding: Market cap to sales is about 1.4x, but listed-peer sales multiples were not found.

va4.finding: A ₹84.2 cr pre-IPO placement was done at ₹272.07 per share, in line with the upper band.

pg1.finding: Promoter holding falls from 84.92% to 75.85% after the issue.

pg2.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

pg3.finding: Related-party transaction figures were not found in public sources.

pg4.finding: No information on regulatory action against promoters was found.

is1.finding: The ₹100.71 cr offer for sale is about 22% of the ₹455.48 cr issue.

is2.finding: The ₹455.5 cr issue is about 10.3% of the ₹4,438 cr post-issue market cap.

is3.finding: The selling promoter's average acquisition cost was not found in public sources.

up1.finding: Unidentified acquisitions are grouped with general corporate purposes in the remaining ~₹85 cr of the fresh issue, so the growth share is not stated.

up2.finding: ₹270 cr of the ₹354.8 cr fresh issue (about 76%) goes to repaying borrowings of the company and its subsidiary Saffire Crop Science.

up3.finding: The amount for general corporate purposes has not been quantified separately.

up4.finding: Public sources don't say whose loans are being repaid.

lg1.finding: Litigation amounts were not found in public sources.

lg2.finding: No information on criminal or regulatory cases was found.

lg3.finding: Contingent liabilities were not found in public sources.

rk1.finding: Customer concentration figures were not found in public sources.

rk2.finding: Supplier concentration figures were not found in public sources.

rk3.finding: The company was founded in 1994, over 30 years ago.

rk4.finding: Auditor remarks were not found in public sources.
